audit_summary: Commits 53f105d and 2d063d1 were invalidated by the neural_networks Benchmark Integrity Audit (VIOLATION_STAMP_INDEX.md / commit 72cc4f0) due to 13 benchmark-path violations in PolyphonicPipeline: (1) forward-time eval target ingestion into the 25.2M abacus table (_ingest_tokens_to_abacus_pinhole), (2) .detach() gradient starvation on neural logits, and (3) 99.5% Koopman ridge solver override. All runs below are post-audit, strictly causal, zero-violation evaluations.

historical_runs.notes: Excised all 13 benchmark-path violations and established the clean post-audit PhaseSheafAnyGram + 2-Layer GRU baseline.
